content: Advance M0130/W0134 by composing StreamGraph planning with CommandResourcePool ownership in a host-independent QueueSubmissionLedger. Resource acquisition and plan validation must be transactional, completion values must be monotonic and generation-bound, and reconfiguration must reject in-flight work. Do not claim vkQueueSubmit2, Vulkan handles, or driver execution.

QueueSubmissionLedger acquires a finite command resource before planning and releases the acquired slot if graph validation fails. It assigns one monotonically increasing completion value only after both admissions succeed, submits the resource to the pool, and recycles only through the observed completed timeline. Generation reconfiguration requires no in-flight resource and resets stream/planner state together.

Implemented QueueSubmissionLedger, acquired-resource cancellation, and positive completion-timeline validation at content revision e272a1d. The ledger composes StreamGraph and CommandResourcePool behind one mutex, emits a generation-bound plan/resource/completion tuple, and resets both authorities only after in-flight work drains.

Focused metaflux.backend.vulkan-stream-graph and full nix develop .#vulkan --command ctest --preset vulkan --output-on-failure passed 88/88; clang-format --dry-run --Werror and git diff --check passed. The implementation remains host-independent and makes no physical Vulkan or vkQueueSubmit2 execution claim.
